modbus_rs485_contracts.reference_behavior: PuppyBus toggles RS485FlowControlPuppies around writes and reads UART data with caller-provided timeout values for the shared auxiliary bus.

modbus_rs485_contracts.reference_behavior: PuppyModbus register block templates enforce Modbus data-count limits and packed standard-layout register mappings before requests reach lightmodbus.
